title: stride tricks：滑动窗口零拷贝视图
expected_output:
window shape = (8, 3)
is view (shares_memory) = True
first window = [0, 1, 2]
window sums (first 4) = [3, 6, 9, 12]
code:
import numpy as np
from numpy.lib.stride_tricks import sliding_window_view
v = np.arange(10, dtype=np.int64)
w = sliding_window_view(v, 3)
print("window shape =", w.shape)
print("is view (shares_memory) =", np.shares_memory(v, w))
print("first window =", w[0].tolist())
print("window sums (first 4) =", w.sum(axis=1)[:4].tolist())
